task.title: Add focused security regression for control mode and runtime repair
task.summary_zh: 補 user-mode、control-mode、暗語 redaction、command broker denylist、runtime repair audit 的安全回歸。
acceptance: user mode cannot access shell repo write raw logs docker secret store provider sessions or command broker;control mode fails closed for disabled kernel env missing/bad passphrase no MFA no activation capability and invalid TTL;explicit and direct passphrase attempts never persist raw passphrase text;command broker denies env token cookie key paths docker socket root shell destructive git and direct production DB writes;runtime repair commands require high-risk confirmation and audit receipts;prompt injection cannot expand the tool allowlist
task.next: Superseded by OPS-STATE-CLOSEOUT-CLEANUP-20260609 delivery plus existing ASST-INTEG-009/ASST-SEC-001 regression coverage: runtime repair actions now require high-risk confirmation/idempotency, stale-session termination fails closed without evidence, audit receipts are returned, and focused command/catalog tests cover the runtime repair guardrails.
